name: Barbell Deadlift
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart and the barbell over your midfoot, then hinge and bend your knees to grip outside your shins.
Pull your chest slightly up, engage your lats to take slack out of the bar, and brace your core tightly.
Push the floor away smoothly through your feet, extending your hips and knees together until you stand tall.
Hinge back at your hips first, then bend your knees once the bar clears them to return it gently to the floor.
tips: Keep the bar gliding close along your shins and thighs from floor to lockout.
Finish tall by squeezing your glutes without leaning backward at the top.
